Descriptions.DescriptionText: Locked loot rooms are marked permanently on the Expansion map. Press M to view them. Green markers are Tier 1 rooms, orange markers are Tier 2 rooms, and the red marker is the Tier 3 room.

There are three functional cards and three room tiers. Keycard 01 opens only Tier 1 doors, Keycard 02 opens only Tier 2 doors, and Keycard 03 opens only Tier 3 doors. There is no functional Tier 4 card or room.

A keycard is consumed when it is swiped. Opening the door creates a temporary reward crate inside the room. Take everything you want before the door closes, because the crate is removed when the door shuts.
Tier 1 rooms provide three different random selections from a pool of useful survival supplies and ammunition boxes.
Tier 2 rooms provide one random Rating 3 military weapon bundle. Tier 3 rooms provide one random Rating 4 military weapon bundle.
Weapon bundles include a compatible magazine, an optic when the weapon supports one, and ammunition. Some bundles also contain useful weapon attachments or accessories.

These Rating 3 and Rating 4 military items have been removed from ordinary map loot. A small dynamic-event exception remains: the AK-74, FAMAS, M79, NV goggles, SCAR-H, SKS, and SVD can still appear very rarely at helicopter crash events.
Keycards spawn as military loot. Card 01 can appear in map loot tiers 1 through 3. Card 02 can appear in tiers 3 and 4. Card 03 appears only in tier 4 military areas.
Room markers show the destination but the map does not show your player position, coordinates, or distance to the room. Navigate using landmarks and normal compass skills.

A keycard door remains open for 120 seconds, followed by a 15-second closing delay. The alarm is disabled, so there is no audible warning. Keep track of your time and leave the room before the door shuts.
The room can be used by anyone while its door is open. Treat the marked locations as dangerous and expect other survivors.
